mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear with a temperature of 74 degrees at Verona City Hall. We have a Waning Gibbous moon and a clear view for the ISS pass at 8:38 PM tonight, rising in the West Southwest over Mount Horeb and traveling toward Belleville in the South Southwest. Overnight temperatures will drop to 52 degrees with no rain expected.

The Verona Plan Commission will gather on October 5th to discuss several land use items, including certified survey maps for Country View Court and Davis Hill Drive. Additionally, the city continues to provide updates on community projects like the new library community center.
Today you can head to Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, the trivia options are plentiful with games at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.
Looking at the report from September 21st, officers responded to a retail theft where a subject was identified via surveillance video and cited for taking Swedish Fish.
It is a great day to stop by for today's flavor, Crazy for Cookie Dough, as the store is open until 10:00 PM.
